aggregates.name: num_records
aggregates.label: Meeting records
aggregates.means: Every meeting record filed for the community, held or not.

aggregates.name: first_visit
aggregates.label: First record
aggregates.means: Date of the community's first meeting record.

aggregates.name: last_visit
aggregates.label: Latest record
aggregates.means: Date of the community's most recent meeting record.

aggregates.name: verified_meetings
aggregates.label: Verified meetings
aggregates.means: Records with meeting_conducted = yes and meeting_type = community_meeting (PDD §3.1).

aggregates.name: verified_weeks
aggregates.label: Weeks with a verified meeting
aggregates.means: Distinct calendar weeks containing at least one verified community meeting.

aggregates.name: step7_done_date
aggregates.label: Step 7 completed on
aggregates.means: Date of the verified meeting at which the community completed Step 7 (Vision).
aggregates.sql: MIN(visit_date) FILTER (WHERE is_verified AND step_done AND step_number = :FINAL_STEP)

aggregates.name: max_step
aggregates.label: Furthest FCAP step
aggregates.means: Highest FCAP step recorded on any meeting.

aggregates.name: hh_represented_sum
aggregates.label: Households represented
aggregates.means: Households represented, summed over verified meetings.

aggregates.name: hh_enrolled_sum
aggregates.label: Households enrolled (per meeting)
aggregates.means: The community's enrolled households, counted once per verified meeting.

aggregates.name: attended_sum
aggregates.label: People attending
aggregates.means: Men plus women attending, summed over verified meetings.

aggregates.name: female_attended_sum
aggregates.label: Women attending
aggregates.means: Women attending, summed over verified meetings.

aggregates.name: spoke_sum
aggregates.label: People who spoke
aggregates.means: Men plus women who spoke, summed over verified meetings.

aggregates.name: female_spoke_sum
aggregates.label: Women who spoke
aggregates.means: Women who spoke, summed over verified meetings.

aggregates.name: repeat_flag_records
aggregates.label: Repeat-count flags
aggregates.means: Community meetings whose men and women attending both equal the previous meeting's (repeat_counts_flag = yes, PDD §5.4).

aggregates.name: location_flag_records
aggregates.label: Location review flags
aggregates.means: Records whose location fix was worse than 50 m or more than 2 km from enrolment (PDD §5.6).

aggregates.name: last_step5_meeting
aggregates.label: Latest held meeting at Step 5+
aggregates.means: Date of the latest held meeting on Step 5 or later.

aggregates.name: last_saving_meeting
aggregates.label: Latest meeting reporting savings
aggregates.means: Date of the latest meeting with currently_saving = 1.

properties.name: active_days
properties.label: Days in active window
properties.means: Days from the first record to Step-7 completion, or to the report date if not yet complete (PDD §8.1 P1).

properties.name: active_weeks
properties.label: Weeks in active window
properties.means: Community-weeks in the active window, counting the first week.

properties.name: reached_step5
properties.label: On Step 5 or later
properties.means: The community has held a meeting on Step 5 or later (savings are asked only from Step 5, PDD §5.5).

properties.name: saving_now
properties.label: Saving at latest meeting
properties.means: The latest held meeting on Step 5+ reported currently_saving = 1.
properties.sql: COALESCE(reached_step5 AND last_saving_meeting IS NOT NULL AND last_saving_meeting = last_step5_meeting, FALSE)

properties.name: completed_on_time
properties.label: Step 7 within 15 weeks
properties.means: Completed Step 7 within 105 days (15 weeks) of the first record (PDD §8.1 P3).
properties.sql: COALESCE(step7_done_date IS NOT NULL AND FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (step7_done_date::timestamp - first_visit::timestamp)) / 86400) <= :ON_TIME_DAYS, FALSE)

indicators_doc.description: One row per community (the followed entity, PDD §6). Indicators from PDD §8 and the review signals of §5.4/§5.6/§7.2.

display.title: Spark facilitator programme (synthetic)
display.targets_note: Targets are the PDD's own (§8.1 P1 ≥ 80%, P3 ≥ 75%). Spark's participation indicators carry no target in the PDD, so they are shown without one. Synthetic data.

meta.label: Meeting regularity
meta.plain: Of the weeks each community has been active, the share with at least one verified community meeting.

meta.label: Step 7 on time
meta.plain: Of enrolled communities, the share that completed Step 7 within 15 weeks of their first meeting — reported, not paid on.
meta.scope_note: PDD §8.1 P3 — target ≥ 75%, reported not priced (§7.4).

meta.label: Household attendance
meta.plain: Households represented at verified meetings, out of the community's enrolled households.
meta.scope_note: PDD §8.2 S1 (Spark's own definition). The PDD sets no target.

meta.label: Women attending
meta.plain: Of everyone attending verified meetings, the share who were women.
meta.scope_note: PDD §8.2 S2. The PDD sets no target.

meta.label: Spoke up
meta.plain: Of everyone attending verified meetings, the share who spoke.
meta.scope_note: PDD §8.2 S3. The PDD sets no target.

meta.label: Women who spoke
meta.plain: Of the women attending verified meetings, the share who spoke.
meta.scope_note: PDD §8.2 S4. The PDD sets no target.

meta.label: Saving
meta.plain: Of communities on Step 5 or later, the share whose latest meeting reported the community is saving.
meta.scope_note: PDD §8.2 S5 — denominator restricted to Step 5+ (§5.5). The PDD sets no target.

meta.label: Verified share
meta.plain: Of every meeting record filed (held or not, community or committee), the share that is a verified community meeting.
meta.scope_note: PDD §8.2 S6. The PDD sets no target.

meta.label: Repeat counts
meta.plain: Of verified meetings, the share whose attendance counts exactly repeat the previous meeting's — a review flag, not a rejection.
meta.scope_note: PDD §5.4 repeat_counts_flag; S-1 review stratum (§7.2). The PDD sets no threshold.

meta.label: Location flags
meta.plain: Of meeting records, the share whose location was worse than 50 m or more than 2 km from the community — reviewed, never a payment condition.
meta.scope_note: PDD §5.6 location_review_flag; S-1 review stratum (§7.2). The PDD sets no threshold.
